App.name: TCU Campus Marketplace
App.description: A student marketplace for Tzu Chi University.

Auth.title: Useful things. New campus homes.
Auth.intro: Pass on a textbook, find a desk lamp, or arrange an exchange with another TCU student.
Auth.privacy: Your email stays off public listings. No payments are handled here.
Auth.errorBody: Use a verified gms.tcu.edu.tw account. Suspended and deleted accounts cannot access the marketplace.
Auth.serverErrorBody: We couldn't reach the server. Please try again in a moment.

Rules.title: Community rules
Rules.intro: Keep exchanges friendly, fair and safe.
Rules.prohibited: Weapons, alcohol, tobacco, medicine, counterfeit goods and academic dishonesty services are prohibited.
Rules.safetyTitle: Meet in a public campus location
Rules.safety: Choose a visible entrance or public landmark during daytime. Avoid private dorm rooms and isolated areas. Inspect the item before agreeing to an exchange.
Rules.payment: The platform does not process payments or guarantee transactions. Agree on price and details directly with the other student.
Rules.exchange: Choose Jieren, Jianguo or Central Campus, select a public exchange point and propose a time. Both students confirm completion.

Onboarding.title: A few details before you start
Onboarding.intro: Help other students recognize you when you meet.
Onboarding.departmentHint: Official TCU teaching-unit directory; department names retain their official Chinese spelling.
Onboarding.accept: I have read and accept the community rules.
Onboarding.error: Please check your details and accept the rules.

Feed.title: Find it on campus
Feed.empty: The marketplace is ready for its first listings.
Feed.emptyBody: Listing creation is being added in the next phase.
Feed.exchangeBody: Arrange a daytime meetup at a public campus exchange point.
Feed.phaseBody: Authentication and layout are ready for configuration. Listings arrive in the next build phase.
Feed.results: {count, plural, =0 {No items} one {# item} other {# items}}

ListingForm.heading: Sell an item
ListingForm.intro: A clear photo and a few details help it find a new home.
ListingForm.title: Item title
ListingForm.photoHint: 1–6 JPEG, PNG or WebP photos, up to 5 MB each. Use × to remove a photo. Alt text defaults to the item title.
ListingForm.error: We could not publish this listing. Check your fields, photos and connection, then retry.
ListingForm.replace: Add photos or remove them with ×. Keep 1–6 photos in total; changes apply when you save.
ListingForm.photoError: Choose 1–6 JPEG, PNG or WebP photos, up to 5 MB each.

Listing.filterDescription: Narrow the items by campus, price, condition and availability.
Listing.gallery: Item photos; use left and right arrow keys
Listing.emptyHint: Try another search or list something you no longer need.
Listing.contactIntro: Choose a public exchange point and propose a time. No payments are processed.
Listing.defaultMessage: Hi, I’m interested in your {title} listed on Campus Marketplace. Is it still available?
Listing.provisional: Provisional landmark — confirm the exact meeting spot with the seller.
Listing.safeHours: Taipei time · 08:00–18:59 · within the next 90 days
Listing.EXCHANGE_TIME_INVALID: Choose a valid date and time.
Listing.EXCHANGE_TIME_PAST: Choose a future date and time in Taipei time.
Listing.EXCHANGE_TIME_TOO_FAR: Choose a date within the next 90 days.
Listing.EXCHANGE_TIME_HOURS: Choose a daytime exchange between 08:00 and 18:59 (Taipei time). Evening exchanges are unavailable.
Listing.contactRateLimit: You have reached today’s exchange request limit. Please try again tomorrow.
Listing.contactUnavailable: This item is no longer available for an exchange. Refresh the listing to see its current status.
Listing.contactSignIn: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
Listing.contactValidation: Check the exchange point and message, then try again.

Dashboard.error: Could not complete the action. Please retry.
Dashboard.deleteAccountHint: Deleting your account hides your listings and blocks future sign-in. Exchange records are retained.
Dashboard.noListings: You have not listed anything yet
Dashboard.noExchangesHint: Exchanges you arrange with other students will appear here.
Dashboard.deleteConfirm: Delete this listing? This can't be undone.

Moderation.intro: Tell us what needs review. Reports are visible only to administrators.
Moderation.error: Could not send report. Please retry.

Admin.title: Admin dashboard
Admin.intro: Understand campus activity, manage listings and keep exchanges running smoothly.
Admin.periodCaption: Live database totals. Trends use Taipei calendar days.
Admin.completedInPeriod: {count} exchanges completed in the last {days} days.
Admin.chartDescription: Daily registrations, products and completed exchanges for the last {days} days. Exact values are available in the daily counts table.
Admin.visibleListings: Visible products from active sellers, across all item states.
Admin.noActions: Admin actions will appear here after your first change.
Admin.noResultsHint: Try another search or clear the filters.
Admin.actionError: Could not save this action. Refresh and check the account or product status.
Admin.suspendHint: This user will lose access and their products will disappear from browsing. Active exchanges will be cancelled and reservations released.
Admin.hideHint: This product will disappear from browsing. Its active exchanges will be cancelled. You can restore the product later.
Admin.actionHint: This change will be recorded in the admin activity log.
